name: monoline
description: Monoline: an open-source UI kit. Plain CSS core, accessible React components, docs, and an AI-readable registry.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @monoline/css && npm run build -w @monoline/react && npm run build -w apps/docs && npm run build --if-present -w monoline -w @monoline/mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @monoline/react && npm run typecheck -w apps/docs
scripts.typecheck:examples: tsc --noEmit -p examples/consumer-types && tsc --noEmit -p examples/dashboard && tsc --noEmit -p examples/auth-settings && tsc --noEmit -p examples/landing
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run check -w @monoline/css && npm run check:docs -w @monoline/react && npm run check:registry && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:scripts && npm run test
